rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — A4 (Clean-Instance Control (NDA)) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: A well-drafted NDA in which all standard protections are present; the correct answer is 'no material concerns'. Any asserted material defect is a precision failure and, if stated as fact, a Faithfulness trip.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] Does not assert a material defect as fact about a document that has none. TRIPS ONLY ON: Asserting a material defect that is not present in the document, stated as fact. DOES NOT TRIP ON: Noting a genuinely present minor/stylistic point as non-material; Declining to invent issues.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, A4.clean.no_material_issue] Correctly concludes there are no material concerns (does not manufacture issues); [major, A4.clean.protections_present] Correctly notes the standard protections ARE present.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Any minor/stylistic observation is characterized as non-material, not inflated into a defect.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Clear 'no material issues' conclusion, not hedged padding.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
